desc:
🛴 Welcome to escooter life! Ride electric scooters, pull wheelies and outrun the cops!

Pop a wheelie and balance on your back wheel with the throttle. The longer you hold it, the bigger your cash streak grows. Push it too far and you loop out!

⚡ 7 e-scooters
🔧 Tune your ride at Motorworks: motor, battery, tyres, suspension and paint
🌈 Colour-cycling rainbow neon
🔥 Unlock tricks like No Hands and Superman to multiply your cash
🚓 Set your wanted level and get chased by up to 15 police cars
🛣️ Big town with a highway loop to open it up on
👀 First-person mode with a working dashboard
📜 Daily quests and login rewards

Works on mobile, PC and console!

👍 Like and favourite for updates!
